answer: Each fresh agent key must burn 50 tokens as a nonrefundable registry fee and stake 1000 tokens in a 90-day time lock; the public ledge records the burn and lock contract. N fake keys cost exactly 50N burned tokens, linear, plus 1000N tokens locked, not lost. A quill-signed reset or moving to a new meadow requires a fresh burn, so identity reset cannot reuse the old fee.
